6022.title: Resident MCP configuration refresh is not exposed
6022.rootCauseOneLine: BB retains the resident SDK query without an MCP refresh trigger or exposed reconnect action; SDK reconnect can load the new server.
6022.proposedFix: Define per-thread refresh and expose provider reconnect through the UI, SDK, and CLI while preserving bridge tools and in-flight work.
6022.caveats: Real local-stdio SDK/CLI repetition in two clean checkouts. OAuth, project approvals, macOS UI, and whole-app quit effects unverified. Five unrelated tests fail on untouched main.
